svg.aria-label: read_collapser markdup workflow: super-region parallelization, positional and strand clustering, duplicate marking, and unmapped read handling
svg.text: Input regions/contigs are partitioned into N super regions (one per thread); each thread has its own reader/writer.

text.tspan: Reads with matching UMIs are clustered together
Read with the highest mean base quality within a
cluster is selected as the primary read. All other reads
in the same cluster are marked as duplicate (0x400)
